checks.text: Switching changes who the shopper sees as the seller (off: "Siam's AquaTrusted seller", on: "Rahim TradersTrusted seller")
With the switch off, the real seller's name is not shown (it showed "Siam's AquaTrusted seller")

notes: With the switch off the page said "Sold by Siam's AquaTrusted seller". With it on it said "Sold by Rahim TradersTrusted seller".
did: As a stranger, looked at who the seller of a product is, with the seller's own name switched off and then on.
